caption:
Public Wi-Fi is handy, but you don't control it. 📶

- Skip banking and shopping on it
- Use your phone's hotspot for important things
- Turn off auto-connect to open networks
- Keep your device updated

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

scenes.text: Is the free cafe Wi-Fi really safe?
scenes.say: Is the free cafe Wi-Fi really safe? Three simple habits help.

scenes.myth: If the Wi-Fi has a name I recognize, it is safe.
scenes.fact: Anyone can create a network with a familiar name. Ask staff for the real one.
scenes.say: A network with a familiar name is not always safe. Anyone can copy a name. Ask the staff for the real one.

scenes.title: On public Wi-Fi
scenes.say: Skip banking and shopping. Use your phone hotspot for important things. And turn off auto connect for open networks.

scenes.title: Install device updates
scenes.say: Bonus tip. Install your device updates. They fix known security holes.
